correctness.rationale: On m≥3 parallel unit intervals, same-edge distance is |u-v|; distinct-edge distance min(u+v,2-u-v), with diameter exactly one. The displayed homotopy pushes ordered same-edge coordinates u<v to ((1−t)u,1−(1−t)(1−v)), while on distinct edges scales (u,v) toward sum one via s=u+v on s≤1 and their complements on s≥1. Direct substitution gives d_t=(1−t)d+t for all d>0; coordinates remain in [0,1], rules agree at s=1 and pole-identifications, so pasting yields a continuous homotopy in the metric quotient and fixes the diametral set pointwise. It is symmetric under edge permutations, pole reversal and particle swap. Thus each U1⊂Ur/F1⊂Fr for 0<r≤1 is equivariant strong deformation retract, with r>1 empty and r=0 excluded. At distance one, unordered space is one vertex with binomial(m,2) loop edges, ordered space two vertices with m(m−1) edges; wedge ranks binomial(m,2) and m(m−1)−1. Permutations act on oriented unordered loops as wedge² of the standard Z^m permutation module; pole swap negates loops. S_m quotient folds one transitive loop to an interval, hence full quotient contractible. Source verify.py 46k-ish exact rational cases are supplementary, not full real-domain proof.
